contract.request: Required email query parameter; last duplicate wins; no trimming or syntax validation. Unicode character limit 255; get_user presence enables details and username fallback.
contract.response: 200 valid=true with data.msg; 409 valid=false with exception. get_user returns first_name,last_name,email,user_id of smallest UUID email match; only if absent, smallest UUID username match.
contract.errors: 400 invalid payload for excessive length; missing query retains production HTML 500 without Allow. Supplied Bearer and scoped identity are checked before method/query. 401/403/405/406 and format 404 retain existing REST behavior. Malformed session fails before method/Bearer with generic HTML 500.
contract.authentication: AllowAny with supplied Bearer authentication. Cache session supplies audit identity only. Anonymous forged scope headers are ignored.
contract.permissions: Current identity/scoped-operation admission; association-bound athlete denied; excluded from collaborator permission registry.
contract.resource_scope: Intentionally global public identifier lookup. Case-insensitive PostgreSQL comparison; excludes soft-deleted accounts, includes inactive accounts. Not a business-resource authorization repository.
contract.side_effects: Read-only checks; managed-table and malformed-session-byte readback unchanged after both real HTTP servers. General shared session middleware may revoke invalid password-hash sessions.
contract.transaction: No business writes. Email performs one SELECT and at most one fallback SELECT; username SELECT EXISTS. Context cancellation and repository failures propagate, never become availability.

Controlled inactive/deleted/duplicate/literal fixtures, Unicode bounds, options/errors, actor/scope/session precedence and 32 concurrent requests have explicit expected results. All managed models remain unchanged.

Real PostgreSQL integration passes under the race detector: 1/16/128/512 duplicates preserve one-query smallest-UUID selection, fallback uses two queries, username uses one EXISTS.
